description: Python script for validating extended attributes in IDL files, including reading attribute definitions from an external file and providing validation logic with custom exceptions.

classes.name: IDLExtendedAttributeValidator
classes.description: Class responsible for validating extended attributes in IDL definitions, using a set of valid attributes loaded from an external file.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the validator with a filename for extended attributes, loading valid attributes.

methods.name: validate_extended_attributes
methods.description: Validates extended attributes for all nodes in the provided IDL definitions.

methods.name: validate_extended_attributes_node
methods.description: Validates extended attributes for a single node (interface, attribute, operation, or argument).

methods.name: validate_name_values_string
methods.description: Checks if a specific extended attribute name and its values are valid according to the loaded definitions.
